name: B10-0442/2026 (Verts/ALE) – The cases of Ali Karimli, Anar Mammadli and other political prisoners in Azerbaijan
title: JOINT MOTION FOR A RESOLUTION on the cases of Ali Karimli, Anar Mammadli and other political prisoners in Azerbaijan
part_text:
The European Parliament is calling for the release of two jailed men in Azerbaijan: opposition leader Ali Karimli, held since November 2025, and election monitor Anar Mammadli, sentenced to 13 years in September 2026. It says their cases are politically motivated and part of a wider crackdown on critics. The Parliament asks the European Union to use its trade power to press Azerbaijan on human rights, including suspending energy trade and freezing cooperation talks until all political prisoners are freed. This is an opinion; it does not itself change any law.

- Nothing changes yet; the Parliament is asking the EU and member states to act.
- It affects Azerbaijan's government, its critics, and EU trade and aid ties.
- Next, EU governments and the Commission decide whether to follow these calls.
